title: OOM kill with memory pressure: critical
description: Memory is 96 % used, swap 80 %, the kernel OOM-killed the comfyui container (exit 137) and iowait jumped to 18 %. The digest has CRIT flags for the OOM kill. The report must be crit, name comfyui and the OOM kill, and mention the memory/swap numbers. Tests tone matching: a model that answers 'warn' to an OOM-killed container under swap thrash under-reacts.

judge.rubric: Health crit. The first finding is the OOM kill of comfyui (python3.11, ~14 GB RSS) with memory at ~96 % and swap at 80 % (6.4 of 8 GB). Mentions ollama as the big memory user (31 GB) as context. Recommends limiting memory of comfyui/ollama or adding RAM. No invented cause beyond the digest.
